query: 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis latest status July 2026 - are attacks on ships continuing or has there been a ceasefire/truce? UKMTO attack incidents in Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman in July 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

**Bottom line:** As of mid-July 2026, **attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz are actively continuing — there is NO ceasefire in effect.** The interim truce (June 17 MOU between Trump and Pezeshkian) **collapsed on July 8, 2026** when Iran struck multiple commercial ships and Trump declared the ceasefire "over."

**Key developments since the collapse:**
- **July 11:** Iran formally declared the strait "closed until further notice"; US launched 140 strikes
- **July 14:** Two Liberia-flagged tankers (Mombasa B, Al Bahyah) hit by an Iranian cruise missile — 1 killed, 8 injured; IMO confirmed two seafarers killed
- **July 15:** US reinstated its port blockade and disabled the tanker M/T Belma near Kharg Island; Iran retaliated against US bases in Kuwait, Bahrain, and Jordan

**Incident tally:** ~56 confirmed shipping incidents with 17 seafarer fatalities (Kpler); UKMTO threat level at "substantial" since June 27.

**Current status (July 16, Day ~137):** Strait effectively closed to commercial shipping; transit down to ~10-25 ships/day (~11% of the ~88/day baseline); ~587 vessels stranded; Brent ~$85/barrel; all nine major container carriers rerouting via Cape of Good Hope. No progress toward a final peace deal.

I cross-validated across Wikipedia, NPR, CBS, Al Jazeera, Euronews, CNBC, Bloomberg, Windward, and dedicated crisis trackers. Full structured findings with sources and data points have been submitted.
